meta.themes: GPT-5.5, Enterprise Agents, Hyperscaler Deals, Markets & Safeguards

news.title: Anthropic and Amazon expanded their partnership for up to 5 gigawatts of Trainium capacity
news.summary: Anthropic committed more than $100 billion over ten years to AWS for Trainium2–Trainium4 capacity, with Amazon investing $5 billion now and up to $20 billion more as the full Claude Platform is readied for native AWS accounts alongside Bedrock.

news.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot gained richer Bing cards, Teams agent sharing, and admin controls for AI video
news.summary: The April 21 release wave added interactive Bing answer cards in Copilot Chat, the ability to share custom agents directly to Microsoft Teams teams, and a new admin-center toggle for AI video generation features across supported apps.

news.title: OpenAI introduced workspace agents in ChatGPT for shared, long-running team workflows
news.summary: Codex-powered workspace agents run in the cloud with org permissions, can connect to business tools and Slack, and are free in preview for Business, Enterprise, Edu, and Teachers plans through May 6 before credit-based pricing begins.

news.title: OpenAI launched free ChatGPT for Clinicians in the U.S. with HealthBench Professional benchmark
news.summary: Verified U.S. physicians, NPs, PAs, and pharmacists get a dedicated clinical mode with skills, trusted medical search, literature deep research, optional HIPAA BAA, and a new open HealthBench Professional evaluation suite for real chat tasks.

news.title: OpenAI released GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5 Pro for ChatGPT, Codex, and soon the API
news.summary: The company positioned GPT-5.5 as a major step in agentic coding, computer use, and knowledge work with strong benchmark gains at GPT-5.4-like latency, plus expanded safety and red-team work before ChatGPT rollout and a planned API release.

news.title: Tesla lifted 2026 capex to over $25 billion as AI, robotaxis, and robots strain investor patience
news.summary: Reuters reported Tesla nearly tripled planned spending versus last year and expects negative free cash flow for the rest of 2026 while Musk doubles down on autonomy and humanoid work without Big Tech's established high-margin cash engines.

news.title: Investors piled back into U.S. stocks as AI-fueled earnings stoked FOMO across sectors
news.summary: Reuters described a broad rotation into equities led by strong megacap results and fear of missing AI-driven gains, with technology, financials, and industrials seen as the main recipients of the renewed risk appetite.

news.title: Google Cloud Next '26 featured Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and Workspace Intelligence
news.summary: Google's recap highlighted Agent Studio, Agent Designer, the Gemini Enterprise app with long-running background agents, Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.7 on Vertex, and customer stories from retailers and manufacturers going agent-first.

news.title: Google detailed eighth-generation TPU 8t and 8i chips plus Vera Rubin NVL72 on Google Cloud
news.summary: Technical posts positioned TPU 8t for training and 8i for inference with a claimed 80% better inference performance per dollar, alongside Virgo scale-out fabric, new agentic data offerings, and Nvidia Vera Rubin systems in its AI Hypercomputer lineup.

news.title: Anthropic detailed election safeguards, bias tests, and TurboVote banners ahead of 2026 midterms
news.summary: The company published evaluation scores for political even-handedness, policy compliance on 600 election prompts, and influence-operation tests, plus nonpartisan voter-resource banners and web-search behavior for U.S. midterm and Brazil election queries.

news.title: Anthropic and NEC agreed to put Claude and Claude Code across 30,000 staff and Japanese industry builds
news.summary: NEC becomes Anthropic's first Japan-based global partner, rolling Claude into security operations, BluStellar consulting, and internal engineering centers of excellence for regulated finance, manufacturing, and public-sector use cases.

news.title: U.S. chip stocks hit records as Intel’s outlook turbocharged a broader AI hardware rally
news.summary: Reuters tied fresh highs in U.S. semiconductor names to Intel's strong forecast on AI-tied CPU demand, underscoring how data-center and PC processor expectations still move the sector alongside accelerator headlines.
